extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals, communications teams, and marketing leaders (CMOs) who need to measure press release performance and ROI
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on which KPIs, tools, and best practices to use to measure the performance and return on investment of press releases, including short- and long-term metrics and how to calculate earned media value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Website Traffic
rubrics_metrics.description: High traffic from your press release shows that people want to learn more; whether you’re driving people to a landing page, your main website, a branded campaign page or an investor relations page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track this by using UTM parameters in your press release links and monitoring your traffic using PR analytics tools. Website traffic translates to brand awareness and is the first step in connecting your press release to business results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leads and Conversions
rubrics_metrics.description: Once customers land on your digital properties, track what they do — form fills, sign-ups or booked meetings that originate from your press release are leads; sales typically count as conversions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track these metrics including dollar amounts because they directly show ROI and are often most compelling for executives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earned Media Value (EMV)
rubrics_metrics.description: EMV is the estimated monetary worth of publicity you gain through unpaid media coverage, like press mentions or social media shares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To measure EMV, calculate the equivalent cost of the same exposure through paid advertising using metrics like impressions, reach and ad rates. EMV translates results into language finance teams understand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand Costs vs. Returns
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost versus return equation forms the foundation of any ROI calculation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include costs such as distribution fees, content creation time, multimedia production and any paid promotion. Include returns that are direct (leads and sales) and indirect (EMV). Track both short-term returns immediately after distribution and long-term benefits that build over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track Media Pickups and Syndications
rubrics_metrics.description: Media pickups and syndications extend the reach of your press release far beyond its initial distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track pickups using press release distribution platforms and media monitoring tools that scan for your company name or keywords. Factor pickups into ROI by estimating the cost of placing an ad on that same property. Record both quantity of pickups and quality of the outlets, because premium publications often carry more influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyze Long-Term Brand Impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Long-term brand impact of press releases may be harder to measure but is often more valuable than immediate results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track brand impact through regular brand awareness surveys, changes in search volume for your brand terms and shifts in sentiment over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Web Analytics and UTM Tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Use web analytics platforms like Google Analytics and set up custom UTM parameters for links in your press release to track exactly where visitors come from and what they do.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These tools show metrics like bounce rate, time on page and conversion rates to understand engagement, not just clicks. Press release platforms may also track views, engagement and traffic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Monitoring and Analytics Tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Media monitoring tools track where and how your press release gets picked up across news sites, blogs and social platforms by scanning the internet for mentions of your brand, keywords and competitors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitoring tools save manual searching and provide data you can't easily gather yourself. Some platforms include sentiment analysis to evaluate whether coverage is positive or negative and other features to save time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Release Distribution Platform Analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution platforms often offer built-in analytics that help you measure press release ROI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They track views, clicks and engagement and may include geographic and demographic data. Reporting features help present results to stakeholders; vendors (e.g., PR Newswire) may provide reports and support to interpret and refine strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine Multiple KPIs to Calculate ROI
rubrics_metrics.description: A combination of the KPIs above can give you the ROI of a press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a mix of website traffic, leads/conversions, EMV, media pickups and long-term brand measures to calculate ROI rather than relying on a single metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate vs. Long-Term Measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure both immediate metrics (clicks, coverage) and long-term effects (brand awareness, sentiment) when evaluating press release success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Immediate metrics show short-term returns after distribution; long-term metrics capture ongoing brand shaping that may deliver greater value over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Success Metrics (FAQ Summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release success can be measured by tracking metrics like media pickups, website traffic, social shares and lead generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A comprehensive ROI considers both immediate and long-term metrics; use the appropriate combination to reflect your goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benchmark for 'Good' ROI
rubrics_metrics.description: A rule-of-thumb benchmark cited: many PR professionals consider a press release successful if the earned media value is at least three times the cost of distribution and creation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that 'good' ROI varies by goals, industry and the specific news; benchmark should improve over time as you refine tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tactics to Improve Press Release ROI
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical ways to improve ROI include targeting the right media contacts, writing compelling headlines, including multimedia elements and timing your release strategically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also add a clear call to action to drive measurable responses and consider working with an experienced distribution partner to reach the most relevant audience.
